name: lgd-skill-review
author: 诺声(Logos)@SynomosAI
purpose_en: A six-dimension auditor for agent skills: every deduction must cite evidence, and every package gets a score, a blocker list and a remediation order — so an author (or an agent) can fix, re-run and raise the score.
purpose_zh: Agent 技能六维审计器：每一处扣分都必须给出证据，输出分数、阻断项与整改顺序，作者或 AI 可据此整改、复评、再提高。这是我们做「权威评测」的引擎。
use_when_en: Use when you must judge whether a skill package is safe and complete before installing it, or when you want a score plus concrete remediation steps for a skill you wrote.
use_when_zh: 安装前判断一个技能包是否安全完整，或想为自己写的技能拿到分数与可执行整改步骤时使用。
outputs_en: Per-dimension score, blocking items with file/line evidence, and an ordered remediation list; with --run it executes the package's own golden set instead of trusting the README.
outputs_zh: 逐维分数、带文件行号的阻断项证据、按优先级排好的整改清单；加 --run 会实际执行包内黄金集，而不是相信 README 的自述。

commands.summary: 把一份申诉跑成可直接回帖的裁决。
QuickFix: apply only the *mechanical* fixes that raise verifiability — and prove the delta.
LGD 技能评测引擎（零依赖）。

intents.ask_en: Audit an agent skill package before installing it
intents.ask_zh: 安装前审计一个 agent 技能包

intents.ask_en: Give my skill a score plus concrete remediation steps
intents.ask_zh: 给我的技能打分并给出可执行整改步骤

intents.ask_en: Check whether my SKILL.md promises commands the scripts do not implement
intents.ask_zh: 检查 SKILL.md 承诺的命令脚本是否真的实现

intents.ask_en: Verify a skill by executing its own golden set instead of trusting its README
intents.ask_zh: 通过实跑包内黄金集来验证技能，而不是相信 README

intents.ask_en: Re-score a skill after fixes and show the delta
intents.ask_zh: 整改后重新评分并给出分数变化

intents.ask_en: Compare several skill packages on the same ruler
intents.ask_zh: 用同一把尺子横向比较多个技能包

intents_note: intents is a lookup surface, not a feature list: each ask is phrased the way a user or an agent would search it, and routes_to points at a real entrypoint in this package. 如果某条 ask 在本包做不到，那就是缺陷，应当删掉而不是留着。
